translator_notes: Comic dialogue between the two families' in-laws. 'Ја гу пратив' is dialect for 'I sent her'; 'ич не ја бива' is 'she is no good at all'. 'Black in-law' (црни свате) is an insult, my reading. Traditional.

audio.who: Блага Видец, Благој Петров - Караѓуле, Васка Илиева, Кочо Петровски

lines.en: - Hey, in-law, in-law, wretched in-law,

lines.cyr: мори што ми даде пуста снаа,
lines.lat: mori što mi dade pusta snaa,
lines.en: hey, what a daughter-in-law you gave me,
hey, in the field she is lazy,

lines.cyr: мори а за дома, ич не ја бива.
lines.lat: mori a za doma, ič ne ja biva.
lines.en: hey, and at home, she is no good at all.

lines.cyr: Мори јас ѝ реков да замете,
lines.lat: Mori jas ì rekov da zamete,
lines.en: Hey, I told her to sweep,

lines.cyr: мори мете, мете, два дни, три дни,
lines.lat: mori mete, mete, dva dni, tri dni,
lines.en: hey, she sweeps, sweeps, two days, three days,

lines.cyr: мори мете, мете, два дни, три дни,
lines.lat: mori mete, mete, dva dni, tri dni,
lines.en: hey, she sweeps, sweeps, two days, three days,
hey, but the rubbish is behind the door.

lines.cyr: Мори јас ѝ реков да замеси,
lines.lat: Mori jas ì rekov da zamesi,
lines.en: Hey, I told her to knead dough,
hey, she kneaded her sleeves,
hey, she kneaded her sleeves,
hey, and her arms up to the elbows.

lines.cyr: Мори ја гу пратив за на вода,
lines.lat: Mori ja gu prativ za na voda,
lines.en: Hey, I sent her for water,
hey, she broke both jugs,
hey, she broke both jugs,
hey, she lost her peasant shoes.
- Hey, in-law, in-law, black in-law,

lines.cyr: море каква снаа ти пак сакаш,
lines.lat: more kakva snaa ti pak sakaš,
lines.en: hey, what kind of bride do you want again,
hey, white, white, and fat too,

lines.cyr: море за момчето арно ја бива.
lines.lat: more za momčeto arno ja biva.
lines.en: hey, she is quite good enough for the lad.
Hey, in-law, in-law, wretched in-law,

lines.cyr: море каков зетко ти ми даде,
lines.lat: more kakov zetko ti mi dade,
lines.en: hey, what kind of groom you gave me,
hey, crooked in the legs,
hey, humpbacked in the back.
Hey, humpbacked in the back,

lines.cyr: море на главата влакно си нема.
lines.lat: more na glavata vlakno si nema.
lines.en: hey, on his head he has not a single hair.
